summary: The product page has to sell a €50 voucher as a gift. Price, stock, the other values and what the voucher is (12 months, online and in store, sent by post) are all there. But the values €10 and €25 are links to other pages, the specifications list „Colour: €50“, and there is no way to add a message or send it by email. Most important: one voucher page with the value as a choice and a gift message.
audience: People looking for a gift, often not sure what the recipient wants.
tasks: Know how and when it arrives

purpose.clear.evidence: Picture of the voucher, its name and „€50.00“ in the first screen.

purpose.tasks.evidence: Values are separate pages („Also available in: €10 | €25“); no gift message field.

content.complete.evidence: How long postage takes is unclear (“dispatched within 2-3 working days” vs. “first class post”); nothing on how to redeem it or check its balance.

content.readable.evidence: A two-sentence description and three short points.

content.errors.evidence: The specifications list the value as „Colour: €50“: a template field that doesn't fit.

content.duplicate.evidence: The €10 and €25 pages repeat this page with another value.

structure.scannable.evidence: Buy box, description, specifications, reviews, related gifts.

action.primary.evidence: „Add to basket“ is the one orange button next to the price.

nav.menu.evidence: The Gifts tab and the sidebar's Gifts entry are marked as current.

visual.brand.evidence: The voucher shows the Millbrook wordmark on the shop's colours.

visual.images.evidence: One small picture; „Click here to enlarge“ opens the bare file. The related products have no alt text.

visual.hierarchy.evidence: Price and the orange button stand out next to the picture.

visual.consistency.evidence: Same product layout as the kettle page.

trust.signals.evidence: „Valid for 12 months“ is clear; there are no reviews and no terms for vouchers.

inventory.why: Shows what arrives; larger, without the enlarge link.
Value as a choice (€10, €25, €50), quantity, gift message, Add to basket.
Into the buy box's value choice.
„Colour: €50“ says nothing; the code can sit in the buy box.
Good gift ideas next to the voucher.

keep: Valid 12 months, online and in store, free first class postage

fix.text: Each value is a separate page
Tiny button and text on phones
Delivery time of the card unclear

add: How to redeem and check the balance
